testCases.title: AC1 - Creating an order with a valid token returns status 201 and an order whose total equals price times quantity.
preconditions: A valid token for the standard user is available unless the case tests authentication
steps: Carry out the behaviour described by AC1: Creating an order with a valid token returns status 201 and an order whose total equals price times quantity.
expected: Creating an order with a valid token returns status 201 and an order whose total equals price times quantity.

testCases.title: AC2 - Creating an order without a token is rejected with status 401.
preconditions: A valid token for the standard user is available unless the case tests authentication
steps: Carry out the behaviour described by AC2: Creating an order without a token is rejected with status 401.
expected: Creating an order without a token is rejected with status 401.

testCases.title: AC3 - An order with no items is rejected with status 400.
preconditions: A valid token for the standard user is available unless the case tests authentication
steps: Carry out the behaviour described by AC3: An order with no items is rejected with status 400.
expected: An order with no items is rejected with status 400.

testCases.title: AC4 - A user cannot read an order that belongs to another user.
preconditions: A valid token for the standard user is available unless the case tests authentication
steps: Carry out the behaviour described by AC4: A user cannot read an order that belongs to another user.
expected: A user cannot read an order that belongs to another user.

testCases.title: AC5 - Deleting an order removes it, so fetching it afterwards returns status 404.
preconditions: A valid token for the standard user is available unless the case tests authentication
steps: Carry out the behaviour described by AC5: Deleting an order removes it, so fetching it afterwards returns status 404.
expected: Deleting an order removes it, so fetching it afterwards returns status 404.
